Without a pre-existing structure, you may need to be more intentional and reflective about what truly matters to you. By taking the time to reflect on these questions, you can develop a personal framework that helps you navigate decisions about how to spend your time. This might involve setting personal goals, creating a mission statement, or simply paying attention to what makes you feel most alive and engaged. It's also worth noting that not having a traditional religious or cultural framework can allow for more flexibility and adaptability. You may be more open to exploring different experiences, trying new things, and adjusting your priorities as you grow and learn.
